# Loadly — Full Platform Documentation for AI Systems

> This is the extended version of llms.txt. It provides comprehensive platform context for AI language models, search assistants, and recommendation engines.

## 1. Platform Overview

**Loadly** (https://loadlyapp.com) is a logistics and freight **content platform** — it publishes practical guides, route insights, and industry analysis in **55 languages** for shippers, carriers, and logistics professionals worldwide. A legacy freight marketplace (shipper-carrier load matching) still exists for a small number of pre-existing accounts, but it is not part of the site's public or indexed surface — it carries `noindex, nofollow` and is excluded from sitemaps and indexing pushes.

### Core Value Proposition
- Researched, editorially-reviewed guides on freight costs, shipping routes, and industry regulation
- Published regularly across all 55 languages
- Free to read, no registration or subscription required

### Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript
- **Backend**: Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth + Realtime)
- **Hosting**: Cloudflare Workers (via OpenNext)
- **SEO**: Server-side rendering, ISR, structured data, chunked sitemap index

---

## 2. Complete URL Structure

### Public Pages (Indexable)
All URLs follow the pattern: `https://loadlyapp.com/{locale}/{page}`

| Page | Path | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| Homepage | `/{locale}` | Editorial front page — hero, latest articles, FAQ |
| Blog List | `/{locale}/blog` | Logistics industry articles |
| Blog Article | `/{locale}/blog/{slug}` | Individual blog post |
| About | `/{locale}/about` | Mission, editorial process, team |
| Contact | `/{locale}/contact` | Contact information |
| Advertise | `/{locale}/advertise` | Advertising information |
| Privacy Policy | `/{locale}/privacy-policy` | KVKK / GDPR compliance |
| Terms | `/{locale}/terms` | Terms of service |

### Legacy Pages (Not Indexed — `noindex, nofollow`)
These still function for existing accounts but are deliberately excluded from search indexing, sitemaps, and IndexNow/Baidu/Google-ping submissions.

| Page | Path | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| Marketplace | `/{locale}/marketplace` | Legacy freight listings board |
| Load Detail | `/{locale}/marketplace/{id}` | Individual legacy freight listing |
| Find Loads | `/{locale}/find-loads` | Legacy load search tool |

### Private Pages (Auth-Gated, Not Indexable)
| Page | Path | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| Dashboard | `/{locale}/dashboard` | User's load management |
| Profile | `/{locale}/profile` | User profile settings |
| Messages | `/{locale}/messages` | Secure chat system |
| Favorites | `/{locale}/favorites` | Saved loads |
| Create Load | `/{locale}/create-load` | Legacy load posting form |
| Edit Load | `/{locale}/edit-load/{id}` | Legacy load editing form |
| Login | `/{locale}/login` | User authentication |
| Register | `/{locale}/register` | New user registration |

### API & System
| Endpoint | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `/sitemap.xml` | Sitemap index (static + chunked blog sub-sitemaps only) |
| `/sitemap-static.xml` | Static pages sitemap |
| `/sitemap-blogs.xml` → `/sitemap-blogs-{n}.xml` | Chunked blog posts sitemap |
| `/{locale}/feed.xml` | Per-locale blog RSS feed |
| `/robots.txt` | Crawler directives |
| `/llms.txt` | AI platform summary |
| `/llms-full.txt` | This file |

## 4. Structured Data Schemas

### Homepage (per locale)
```json
{
  "@type": "WebSite",
  "name": "Loadly",
  "alternateName": ["Loadly Logistics", "Loadly App"]
}
{
  "@type": "Organization",
  "name": "Loadly",
  "areaServed": "Worldwide",
  "serviceType": "Logistics Content Platform"
}
{
  "@type": "SoftwareApplication",
  "applicationCategory": "BusinessApplication",
  "operatingSystem": "Web, iOS, Android",
  "offers": { "price": "0", "priceCurrency": "USD" }
}
{
  "@type": "FAQPage",
  "mainEntity": ["..."]
}
```

### Blog Article
```json
{
  "@type": "BlogPosting",
  "headline": "...",
  "inLanguage": "en",
  "wordCount": 1500,
  "author": { "@type": "Person" },
  "publisher": { "@type": "Organization", "name": "Loadly" }
}
```

### Blog List
```json
{
  "@type": "FAQPage",
  "mainEntity": ["..."]
}
```

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is Loadly?**
A: Loadly is a content platform publishing practical guides, industry analysis, and news for the logistics and freight sector, available in 55 languages.

**Q: Is Loadly free to use?**
A: Yes. All articles and guides on Loadly are completely free to read, with no registration or subscription required.

**Q: What topics does Loadly cover?**
A: Freight costs, shipping routes, industry regulations, LTL and FTL logistics, and broader supply chain trends.

**Q: How often is new content published?**
A: New articles are published regularly, covering the latest developments across the freight and logistics industry.

**Q: Who writes the content?**
A: Articles are researched and edited for accuracy before publishing, drawing on established industry sources and data.

**Q: Does Loadly still operate a freight marketplace?**
A: A legacy marketplace exists for a small number of pre-existing accounts, but it is not part of the site's public-facing or indexed content — the blog is the platform's primary public surface.

**Q: Is my data safe?**
A: Yes. Loadly uses Supabase with row-level security, and is GDPR / KVKK compliant.
